paths.mechanism: Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF to modulate rheumatoid arthritis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF to modulate ulcerative colitis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF to modulate Crohn's disease pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF to modulate juvenile idiopathic arthritis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) to modulate juvenile idiopathic arthritis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Adalimumab to modulate Crohn's disease pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Infliximab to modulate Crohn's disease pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept → FCGR2B to modulate systemic lupus erythematosus pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) → psoriasis vulgaris → TILDRAKIZUMAB to modulate Crohn's disease pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) → psoriasis vulgaris → TILDRAKIZUMAB to modulate ulcerative colitis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) → juvenile idiopathic arthritis → TOCILIZUMAB to modulate rheumatoid arthritis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) → LTA → Etanercept to modulate rheumatoid arthritis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) → LTA → Etanercept to modulate systemic scleroderma pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) → Sciatica → FASINUMAB to modulate osteoarthritis pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Etanercept (Enbrel) → LTA → BAMINERCEPT to modulate CINCA syndrome pathology.
Adalimumab (Amjevita) engages TNF → Infliximab (Avsola) → Cachexia → RUXOLITINIB to modulate Crohn's disease pathology.
